sourceSemantics.stake: Transfer caller OHM then rebase; _rebasing chooses sOHM versus indexed gOHM. Immediate _send only when _claim true and warmupPeriod zero, otherwise accrue recipient warmup gons and reset expiry.
sourceSemantics.unstake: _rebasing true pulls caller sOHM with allowance; false burns caller gOHM in gOHM raw units and converts via balanceFrom. Optional _trigger invokes rebase and includes bounty. Transfer resulting OHM to _to after contract-balance check.
sourceSemantics.wrap: Pull sOHM from caller and mint gOHM to recipient using gOHM.balanceTo; not an OHM-input function.
sourceSemantics.unwrap: Burn caller gOHM and transfer indexed sOHM to recipient using balanceFrom; not a direct OHM-output function.
sourceSemantics.claim: Release recipient warmup gons as chosen sOHM/gOHM when epoch.number >= expiry and expiry nonzero; otherwise return zero. Requires recipient caller unless recipient enabled external deposits/claims. Does not call rebase itself.
sourceSemantics.forfeit: Clear caller warmup gons and return original deposit OHM, relinquishing warmup gains. No third-party claim or arbitrary execution.

limitations: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity, current executability, successful transaction, balance, backing, liquidity or financial-safety attestation. Exact grants, canonical calldata, pause overlays and independent execution policies remain mandatory. All admitted calls require zero native value.

Current official app labels the product wrapping (previously Stake), binds Ethereum STAKING to this exact direct deployment and actively wires OHM→gOHM via stake(to,amount,false,true), gOHM→OHM via unstake(to,amount,false,false), sOHM→gOHM via wrap and sOHM→OHM via unstake(to,amount,false,true). This is not deprecated V1 staking/wsOHM or a claim of current rebase rewards/APY.

Immutable constructor token identities: OHM V2 0x64aa3364F17a4D01c6f1751Fd97C2BD3D7e7f1D5 and sOHM V2 0x04906695D6D12CF5459975d7C3C03356E4Ccd460 use 9 decimals; gOHM 0x0ab87046fBb341D058F17CBC4c1133F25a20a52f uses 18 decimals. stake amount is OHM; wrap amount is sOHM; unwrap amount is gOHM; unstake amount is sOHM when _rebasing=true and gOHM when false. Never interchange units.

OHM staking and sOHM transfer-based unstake/wrap require balances and allowance to staking. gOHM unstake/unwrap burns directly from caller through staking authority, without caller gOHM allowance. gOHM mint/burn wiring and index remain dependency-authoritative; no current authorization/storage state attestation.

Warmup is configurable: stake only immediately delivers if _claim=true and warmupPeriod=0; otherwise records recipient warmup, accumulates gons and resets expiry. An account defaults to self-only warmup deposits/claims; stored lock=true actually enables external deposits/claims. toggleLock changes that authorization setting and is excluded. claim can return zero before maturity and does not itself advance epochs; forfeit returns original deposit and relinquishes gains.

stake invokes rebase; unstake optionally invokes it when _trigger=true. Rebase can call governor-configured distributor.distribute/retrieveBounty and dependencies can revert. A bounty, if any, is included in stake/unstake amount; standalone rebase maintenance is excluded. No current yield, distributor, bounty, warmup or epoch cadence is asserted.

Indexed gOHM conversions use floor division: balanceTo(amount)=amount*10^18/index and balanceFrom(amount)=amount*index/10^18. Small positive amounts may round to zero. No minimum-output/deadline argument exists; caller must choose intended recipient and manage index/rounding. Unstake checks available contract OHM; wrap/unwrap depend on sOHM inventory/mint-burn authority.

Only this Ethereum staking/wrapping interface is admitted. No V1 migration, bridge, governance vote/delegation, Cooler loan, treasury, distributor administration or arbitrary executor capability is included; gOHM governance/Cooler utility does not grant those functions.
